node.statement: For the arbitrary datum fixed in 1.2, that node supplies the required explicit Stage-3 amplified four-corner datum; 1.3 and 1.4 identify its two diagonal fixed maps with the displayed gamma_UU and gamma_VV and prove them bijective; and 1.5-1.6 identify its two cross fixed maps with the displayed gamma_UV and gamma_VU and prove them bijective. Since the datum was arbitrary and 1.1 supplies universal constants with all required inequalities and witness validity, the full root claim follows.
